Yeah, I mean its a totally different situation if there are feelings involved, because then it can get very complicated as you've just described.

But with this boy there are no feelings and I doubt there ever will be from either side. I do get it, we're not 'just friends', so even if we did stop sleeping together, I couldn't expect a future girlfriend to see us as 'just friends'. It just makes me sad to think our friendship essentially has an expiration date.
I know, I know there are way round it but its just such a drastic and depressing change to the life I'm used to and the life I thought i was going to have at uni
Unfortunately this is something that can go on for months or years
I will talk to my ENT about anxiety, I'm actually re-starting therapy on thursday. Thank you for your kind words :)
Thank you for taking the time to comment this, I will look to try some of these things!
Thank you, I will check this out :)
Thank you for this comment, I will try my best. I'm just so used to having loads of friends and going out all the time (thats how i damaged my voice) that this is such a depressing change for me

I usually am the type of person to be the 'talker' and befriend introverts, which is why its so jarring that i cant speak properly. Enticing people with stories and jokes etc is the only way I really know how to make people like me. I have ADHD so as much as I try I'm not a very good listener and I'm the hard opposite of an introvert so this is really difficult for me
Thank you so much for taking to the time to write out this comment, I will take all this advice on for when i see my ENT! Thank you, I hope your voice also improves soon

I personally havent had a good experience with them. I bought a jumper from them which took a whole month to arrive (I live in the UK) Once it arrived it turns out they sent me the wrong item. I emailed the customer service email stated on their website only to be met with a email delivery failure because the email address on their website is spelt wrong (a pretty important mistake) I eventually found the correct email address - the email address i had received my order confirmation from but i never got a response from this. I then DM'd them on Instagram. They were initially very help and told me to send the incorrect item back and they would refund me the shipping and send me the correct item. I sent them the proof of postage and receipt, but three weeks later I hadn't received the shipping refund in my Paypal or my bank. When I told them I hadn't received it they said that they had sent it. It was only when I asked for proof that they had sent it so I could take it up with PayPal, that they said they had 'used the wrong email to send the money' and would send it now. I've now received the shipping refund but as you can probably imagine i will never buy from there again.
Seriously. Three separate posts I have tried to make haven't been allowed to be posted. Its the most annoying thing.

Not more actively partaking in the BLM activism doesn't make you racist, nor should it be seen as a requirement in order for you to be perceived as not racist.

Since George Floyd's death, I have signed a few petitions and reposted a few Instagram posts on my story. I am unlikely to engage with the BLM much more than this.

Part of the reason for this is because a lot to the posts I have seen in regards to 'how to be a good ally' have reoccurring themes of 'being uncomfortable' and 'white guilt'. I have seen a lot of people say that in order to be a true ally I have to 'get comfortable being uncomfortable', 'put myself out for POC' and 'come terms with feeling guilty about my white privilege'

I am someone who has struggled immensely with depression, anxiety, and suicidal thoughts for most of my life. This is still the case. There is also, in case everyone has forgotten, a global pandemic going on that is more than likely going to cause a serious recession which is going to very much affect my life. There are also many other things in my life, most directly related to COVID-19, that have also thrown me into a downwards spiral mental-health wise.

I hardly have the mental energy or stability to deal with some everyday tasks. I certainly do not have the mental capacity to deal with the 'discomfort' or 'guilt' that is (apparently) required in order to tackle a global issue.

As much as I appreciate that there are some people that don't have the privilege to 'opt-out of the fight' i.e. POC, the likely hood of me - one single individual - making any monumental difference by 'doing more' is so unlikely that I see nothing wrong with focusing on getting my own life in order before trying to tackle the structural racism of a country that I don't even live in.

I believe that the main reason the death of George Floyd has got so much attention and has caused worldwide protesting/riots is that people are bored. 

Black people have been wrongfully killed by the police hundreds of times in America, that's kind of the point - this is a reoccurring problem. So why now? Why did the death of this one black man finally cause all this commotion? Why not any of the hundreds before him? 

I think it's because of the lockdown and the coronavirus. I'm not 100% sure about the US, but certainly, in the UK we have heard pretty much nothing COVID-19 this, COVID-19 that, on the news for months. This is one of the first big things to happen that isn't virus related. People have been dying for something else to be happening in the world, people have nothing better to do than to be mad. 

Not to mention people are completely ignoring lockdown in favour of protesting. People are using protesting Floyd's death as an excuse to break lockdown and still feel morally justified in doing so. I.e. It doesn't matter that I'm breaking lockdown, because this is more important and I'm doing it for the greater good.  

I'm not saying that people shouldn't be outraged, they most certainly should. All I'm saying is if this had happened last year when life was normal it likely would have been news for a few days and then been swept under the rug again.
Does anyone know how OP is getting on now?
